name: Kennebec County, ME
findings: Kennebec County has 537 nonprofit organizations. 158 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 130 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Kennebec County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few religious organizations list public events
observations.text: 9 religious organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 21 would.

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for public events through religious groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Political organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 10 political organizations here list membership, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do political organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Professional organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 27 professional organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 27 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do professional organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
